description: Comune di Arezzo publishes these complementary geotopographic layers: external access points and driveways, road surfaces and adjoining verges. Coverage is the municipality of Arezzo. The group contains 2 separately identified thematic components; ZIP and other format representations are retained within those components. External access points and road surfaces are defined as physical features in the provider descriptions. The native metadata lists Shapefile, GeoJSON, GML and KML distributions. The resource licence URL names CC BY 4.0, while the structured licence-type code is A26_CCBY20 and package licence says CC-BY. The applicable version is unresolved. Metadata is publicly readable; file-use charges are not stated. Observation dates, positional accuracy, field completeness and current service operation remain unverified; catalogue timestamps describe metadata changes. No specific simulation application is documented, so no simulation method is assigned. Related municipal road or building resources may represent other classes or earlier publications; exact member identities are retained. No archive, feature collection, map or dataset body was read. An additional 4 broader archive packages cover Immobili e Antropizzazioni, Viabilità, Mobilità e Trasporti, Strade, Edificato. These source-defined class hierarchies overlap the individual layers already listed; package counts do not establish additional disjoint classes. The accompanying RDF is catalogue metadata. Archive contents and feature equivalence remain unverified.
